title: The Father's emanations one beside another

segments.core_english: {3} the Father, one after another. {4} in this manner: '{5}
segments.removed_material: Stripped 'ⲡⲁⲭⲉ' / 'He said' attribution formula — embedded dialogue frame.
segments.temporal_note: Substantive content describes the sequential emanation from the Father; the only frame element is the embedded 'He said'. The 'one after another' formula is the structural opening of the enumeration to follow.

segments.core_english: {7} from his mind, the Beloved of the Lights;
segments.temporal_note: First emanation: from the Father's mind → the Beloved of the Lights. Pure correspondential mapping faculty→cosmic being, both sides internal to the system.

segments.core_english: {10} the Mother of Life; from his teaching {11}
segments.temporal_note: Second emanation: Mother of Life (Mother of the Living, ⲧⲙⲉⲩ ⲙ̄ⲡⲱⲛϩ̄), and the next member 'from his teaching' begins the third. Substrate enumeration.

segments.core_english: the Beloved; from his counsel, the Virgin of Light; {13}
segments.temporal_note: Third and fourth emanations: 'the Beloved' (completing the previous mapping), and from his counsel → the Virgin of Light (ⲧⲡⲁⲣⲑⲉⲛⲟⲥ ⲙⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓⲛⲉ — key substrate marker).

segments.core_coptic: ⲃⲁⲗ ⲙ̄ⲡⲉϩⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ Ⲧϩⲉ ⲟⲩⲛ ⲧⲉ ⲧⲉⲓ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲧⲱϩⲙ̄{14}
segments.core_english: from his reflection.' Thus then is the manner in which they were called forth, {15}
segments.temporal_note: Fifth emanation: from his reflection (ⲡⲉϩⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ), completing the five-fold faculty→being mapping. The summary clause 'Thus then is the manner…' is internal substrate recapitulation, not editorial application.

segments.core_coptic: ⲛⲓⲱⲧ ⳨⳨ⲉ ⲛ̄ⲟⲓⲛⲉⲓ ⲁⲩⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲙⲡ⳨ⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲉⲗⲟⲥ {16}
segments.core_english: Fathers — in this coming they came forth from the Five Members {17}
segments.temporal_note: Closing structural statement: the Five Fathers come forth from the Five Members (ⲡ⳨ⲟⲩ ⲙⲙⲉⲗⲟⲥ = the Five Limbs). Cosmic→cosmic mapping, the chapter's titular teaching.

segments.core_coptic: ⲟⲩⲉ ⲉⲓ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲛⲟⲩⲉ ⲁϩⲟⲱⲗⲡ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ϩⲙ̄ ⲡⲉϩⲕⲁⲗⲣⲟⲥ
segments.core_english: one came forth from another, and was revealed forth from his lot.
segments.temporal_note: Sequential-emanation formula closing the teaching: each Father emerges from his appointed 'lot' (ⲕⲁⲗⲣⲟⲥ = κλῆρος). Internal cosmic structure.
